categories.main_business_segments: Jinko Solar primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of solar PV components, including monocrystalline silicon rods, silicon wafers, solar cells, and PV modules. The company also develops and sells energy storage products and provides integrated solar energy solutions globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced N-type TOPCon cell technology, achieving high conversion efficiencies (over 26.7% in mass production and 34.22% in lab for tandem cells). It uses vertical integration from silicon wafer production to module assembly, leveraging technologies such as large-size wafers, multi-busbar cells, half-cut cells, and bifacial modules. Digitalization and intelligent manufacturing, including AI and IoT, are core to its production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinko Solar serves global PV power plant investors, developers, contractors, and distributors of distributed PV systems. Its products cater to large-scale utility projects and residential/commercial distributed generation markets. Key markets include China, the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing bases and sales networks across China, the United States, Vietnam, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, and other countries. It has a significant presence in China, Europe, the Americas, and rapidly growing markets in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinko Solar operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer covering upstream (silicon wafer production), midstream (solar cell manufacturing), and downstream (module assembly and sales) segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. It also extends into energy storage solutions, integrating solar and storage technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on N-type TOPCon technology and tandem perovskite cells to improve efficiency and reduce costs. It invests heavily in R&D, digital manufacturing, and global capacity expansion, including smart factories and overseas production facilities. It also emphasizes developing integrated solar-plus-storage solutions to support energy transition.
categories.revenue_model: Jinko Solar generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic products including silicon wafers, solar cells, and modules. It also earns income from energy storage system sales and related services. Revenue is derived from direct sales to global customers, including power plant developers and distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinko Solar is a global leader in the PV industry, ranking first in global module shipments for six consecutive years. It competes with other major PV manufacturers such as Trina Solar, LONGi Green Energy, and Canadian Solar. Its competitive edge lies in advanced technology, vertical integration, global manufacturing footprint, and diversified market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinko Solar reported revenues of approximately RMB 92.47 billion, a 22% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to intensified market competition and price declines. Net profit attributable to shareholders dropped sharply to RMB 98.9 million. Despite short-term challenges, the company maintains a large asset base (~RMB 121 billion) and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, aiming for stable long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinko Solar emphasizes high-efficiency, high-reliability PV products with leading N-type TOPCon technology and innovative tandem cells. Its vertically integrated production ensures cost control and quality. The company offers differentiated products with superior power output, durability, and adaptability to extreme environments, supported by global localized services and a commitment to sustainable, zero-carbon manufacturing.
